ops.text: A Sprite lane's Show me screenshots have no documented route to the coordinator's Mac. The brief says the drive relay carries each picture a word's file shows by its Sprite path, but ~/.local/bin/drive sends only read_text of files named as words, so drive pr add refused a PR body whose images were Sprite paths ('neither a link nor a file here') after a 40-minute wait. The working route, copied from #5389, is an orphan durable-agents-<job>-shots branch linked by raw.githubusercontent.com sha URL; the brief or the relay should name or do that.
